title: Venture Global H1 2025–H1 2026 LNG volume-price revenue proxy decomposition
method: Symmetric two-factor Shapley decomposition of V×P. Volume contribution=(V1−V0)×(P0+P1)/2; price contribution=(P1−P0)×(V0+V1)/2.
units: USD millions; 1 TBtu × 1 USD/MMBtu = 1 million USD
interpretation: Volume growth was the positive driver; lower average prices offset part of its gross value
Average LNG selling price is company-wide, not a DOE destination FOB price
Price-volume proxy may differ from reported revenue because of contract mix, derivatives, timing and other items
Two-factor decomposition is arithmetic, not a causal geopolitical attribution
No determination of which share of volume increase went to Europe or displaced Russia
No company profit or net US national benefit inferred
